login.title: Donyo ikind juwadi mi channel
login.welcome: Jolowu kendo! Dony pi gwoko lembe peri.
login.heroTitle: Dongo kuloka peri mi wil ngom ku dhanu ceke ma ikelo
login.heroIntro: Kabedo acel mi ketho nying juruwil ku ju ma giyiko ot, gwoko rwom pa juruwil peri man ilub tokgi nitundu ikum booking.

register.title: Kyewo nying dhanu i sekond
register.text: Cwal juruwil peri man tic ma gimaru.

protect.title: Gwoko piny marom
protect.text: Lembe peri bibedo peri pi kare mi gwoko, wek ngati moko ope ma copo kwayo juruwil peri marom.

track.title: Lub rwom ceke
track.text: Nen lembe pa ngati acel acel man lembe pare zo, nicaku i rombo pare mir acel nitundu i kare ma juwilo.

handover.title: Credit i saa mi booking
handover.text: Ka jawil moko ugoro buku, jubi miyo igi jara ot man in re ma igoro nying peri calu jara tic.

login.secure: Dony maber - lembe pa juruwil peri bibedo ling
login.builderLink: Dony i portal pa juyiku ot

signup.title: Kyewo nying juwadi mi channel
signup.intro: Caku akaunti peri mi caku kiewo nying peri man gwoko dhanu peri giri.
